concept: Lambda: SQS event source mapping for serverless queue processing
tests: Choosing the least labor-intensive serverless way to process SQS that scales with message count and charges only for work done.
expected: Lambda + SQS event source mapping: Lambda polls the queue itself, scales concurrency with volume, you pay for execution time. Triggers: "serverlessly", "scale based on number of messages", "pay only when processed", "least operational overhead".
why_not: ECS on EC2 and an EC2 ASG require managing instances; EKS — the heaviest to administer.
